subject: Nimbus: ISO/FedRAMP scope clarifications and intake
messages:
From: Elena Morales <security@nimbus-payments.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial questions — ISO scope & FedRAMP readiness

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the intro last week. Nimbus is in discovery for an LLM inference provider for our payments risk workflows. Before we move forward I'd like to clarify a few things for our security intake and procurement:

- Scope: can you confirm whether Redwood's ISO 27001 scope covers production inference and key management? Specifically: model serving, logs, and customer data retention.
- FedRAMP readiness: do you have a current FedRAMP timeline or gaps we should be aware of for low-impact SaaS?
- Evidence: what sample artifacts can you provide up-front (control descriptions, CAIQ/SIG, encryption architecture diagrams, retention policy)?
- Timeline: we are aiming for vendor review by Jan 20 — any chance of a short intake packet this week?

Appreciate any pointers. If easier, we can set a 30-min call — I'm available Friday afternoon PST.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of InfoSec
Nimbus Payments

Attachment: nimbus_intake_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <security@nimbus-payments.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Jan 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial questions — ISO scope & FedRAMP readiness

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps below: 

- ISO 27001 scope: Our certified scope includes production inference and associated WAAS (web + API) components; key management in our hosted offering uses KMS with HSM-backed keys for customer secrets. On Private deployments customers can bring their own KMS/HSM.
- FedRAMP: we are not FedRAMP-authorized today. We maintain a FedRAMP readiness roadmap (controls mapped) and have annual third-party assessments planned; timeline for authorization varies by program but we can share the readiness gap matrix.
- Evidence: we can provide CAIQ/SIG exports, SOC 2 framework mapping (in-progress), encryption diagrams, and our retention policy.
- Timeline: we can assemble a focused intake packet by Mon 1/12 if you can confirm the key artifacts you want prioritized.

Proposed immediate next step: 30-min call so we can align scope and agree the artifact set for Jan 20. Suggested times: Fri 1/9 2:00–3:30pm PST or Mon 1/12 9–11am PST.

I'll attach our evidence mapping template and loop in Karthik (controls lead) and Marcus (compliance operations).

— Soojin
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_evidence_map_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial questions — ISO scope & FedRAMP readiness

Adding some operational detail for the intake packet:

- Evidence owners: I'll own IAM / access control artifacts; Marcus will own logging/retention and infra diagrams; Olga will pull encryption/KMS pieces.
- Artifacts we can prioritize: control narrative for Prod inference, key rotation policy, KMS architecture diagram (hosted + BYOK notes), sample audit logs (anonymized), and CAIQ export.
- Quick ask for Elena: do you need sample penetration test reports or only control narratives and configuration evidence for the first pass?

I'll block time to prepare the mapping template and start filling rows this afternoon.

Karthik
Director, Applied Security
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morales <security@nimbus-payments.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Peter Liu <p.liu@auditpartners.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial questions — ISO scope & FedRAMP readiness

Thanks — that approach works. For the first pass Nimbus needs: CAIQ/SIG, control narratives for Prod inference, KMS architecture, sample retention and logging artifacts. Pen test reports are helpful but not mandatory for this intake.

I've attached our standard SIG/CAIQ for suppliers and set a vendor review target of Jan 20. Please note the auditor (Peter Liu at Audit Partners) will look for evidence traceability (control->artifact->owner).

Attachment: Nimbus_SIG_v2.pdf (questionnaire)

Elena

1) We'll upload CAIQ export + control narratives to the shared drive by Tue 1/13 EOD.
2) Evidence mapping (control -> artifact -> owner -> doc link) will be created in SUP-3412 (Jira) and we'll attach doc links there.

I'll send a calendar invite after Elena confirms.
